Name: Mod Update Menu
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=4]See unofficial update for the latest SDV version here: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-160#post-123104]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-160#post-123104[/url][/size][size=6]

Mod Update Menu

[/size][size=4]This mod adds a menu to the title screen which shows the update status of all your mods and SMAPI. It also provides a link to update the mod/SMAPI if it is out of date.

[/size][size=4]How to use:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Press the new button that appears in the main menu on the left to open the menu.[/size]
[*][size=4]Press the column names to sort by that column (it cycles through ascending and then descending).[/size]
[*][size=4]Hover over each entry in the menu to see more info (author name, why it is outdated, full url).[/size]
[*][size=4]Click on the Link entry (i.e. NexusMods) to have your browser open up the download page.[/size]
[*][size=4]Use the scroll wheel to scroll up and down through all your mods.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
The left indicator on the button is for SMAPI (green checkmark = SMAPI is up to date, yellow exclamation mark = SMAPI is outdated), and the right one if for your mods (same scheme as for SMAPI).[/size]
[size=4]Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI 3.6.
